about: Shot list for the homepage preview (scripts/capture-preview.mjs). Both segments open the LEO mission as a deep link, with the interface hidden (ui=0) and the rocket's frame-stepped clock (virt=1: each rendered frame is exactly 1/30 s, advanced by window.__rocketAdvance). The clock only moves when advanced, so the page is stepped while it loads, until the launch site is on screen and the dissolve into it has finished. Mission times are seconds from liftoff (engine start T-3.0 s, stage separation T+151.2 s).

segments.name: launch
segments.about: On the pad from T-4 s to T+2 s: the engines start (T-3 s), the exhaust cloud spreads across the pad and the rocket lifts off its mount (T-0).

segments.name: staging
segments.about: High above the Earth from T+155.0 s to T+159.5 s: the stages, released at T+151.2 s by pneumatic pushers, drift apart at walking pace, and the upper-stage engine starts (T+158.2 s).
